extraction.summary_en: This filing is a copy of ARCHEAN TECHNOLOGIES' updated statuts (SAS) dated 30 November 2010 (with a closing date mention of 4 November 2010), filed with the object/activity-change registry labels. Article 6 ("Apports") recites the company's capital history from constitution (2004) through four successive increases up to the current 368,102 € capital, and Article 7 ("Capital social") states the current capital is split into 217,241 preference A shares and 150,861 preference B shares. No named shareholders or transfers appear anywhere in the document; only aggregate capital figures and share counts are given.

evidence.quote_fr: Le capital social est fixé à la somme de 368.102 euros. Il est divisé en 368.102 actions de 1 euro chacune entièrement libérées. Il est divisé en actions de préférence de catégorie A et en actions de préférence de catégorie B, à savoir : 217.241 actions de préférence de catégorie A, 150.861 actions de préférence de catégorie B.

issues: Cover page states statutes were updated on 30 November 2010, but the final page states 'Mis à jour le 4 novembre 2010' — the two dates conflict and it is unclear which reflects the true update date.

The AGE of 27 June 2008 that divided the nominal value of shares by 100 (from presumably 100 € to 1 € nominal) changes neither capital nor shareholding percentages; recorded only as a snapshot, no CAPITAL_INCREASE/DECREASE event emitted for it.

No named shareholders, holding percentages, or transfer history appear anywhere in this filing; the préférence A/B share counts in Article 7 cannot be attributed to specific holders from this document alone.

The two 27/06/2008 capital increases (17,241 € and 150,861 €) numerically match the préférence A (217,241 shares) and préférence B (150,861 shares) totals in Article 7, suggesting they correspond to the creation of these classes, but this filing contains no explicit 'création de catégorie' resolution text to confirm this as a CAPITAL_DUAL_CLASS event.
Methods (numeraire / apport en nature / incorporation de réserves) for the 2005, 2006 and 2008 increases are not stated in this document beyond the amounts and resulting capital.
